desc:
⚗️Welcome to Lab Escape Obby⚗️ Navigate through a challenging obstacle course set in a laboratory. Escape the lab by overcoming 40 various stages in this thrilling Obby adventure. 

Major Update September 20206 
🏷️ New Titles — Unlock and equip your favorites!
🧱 Updated Stages — Better and smoother progression!
🌀 New Coils — Super Speed and Super Jump!
🎨 New Visuals — Updated icons, effects, and menus!
⚡ Unlock 12 unique Trails
🛠️ Leaderboards now show the top 50 instead of the top 10

Update 1 
- 10 New Stages 
- Flying Game Pass 
- Better Guidance 
- New Badges 

👍 Like and favorite⭐the game to support future updates!

Be the first to know about exciting updates, exclusive content, and new releases by joining the "Snow Moose Games" group here on Roblox!
